implementedEvidence: Trusted qualifier plus exact DataSource object identity and independently approved endpoint/role/schema/path binding before open.
ORIGINAL JDBC login check aborts a bootstrap login before catalog SQL; native current_user/session_user/TCP endpoint/version/posture.
MEMBER closure intentionally conservative, includes NOINHERIT; benign managed role accepted; options/grantor included in hash.

Database CREATE/TEMP/foreign CONNECT, every-schema CREATE, global owner dependency/user mapping, catalog/parameter authority and every materialized history relation/column privilege incl PG17+MAINTAIN.
Large-object metadata ACL and foreign wrapper/server/user-mapping metadata/options; payload, history rows, routine/GUC/remote credential literals are not returned.
Expected privilege hash remains external signed trust-anchor input; native capture is not an approval baseline.
limitations: AUTHOR_ONLY; root independent initial-clock counterexample and full security review are pending; these successful cases cannot refute an untested counterexample.
No provider registration, eight-service runtime-only wiring, thirteen-stream bootstrap, actual external native definition/provenance producer or active lease/offline fence integration.

Privilege hash is not a complete table constraint/default/RLS-expression/trigger semantic fingerprint. Full definition/provenance native proof must remain a separately independently approved producer/fence obligation.
Inspection is a startup snapshot, not continuous monitoring or proof against privileged DBA/host compromise.

No production SQL, G0/G2 historical register/DDL, source wiring, migration role grants, server reset, commit or G3 authorization performed.
Frozen-source tests use controlled fixture DDL/roles, not a production/customer adoption or end-to-end domain acceptance claim.
